'''2009 2K Event Day 1 Seth Binfield LS Jabba's Palace: Audience Chamber''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Seth Binfield]] at [[2009 2K Event]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Jabba's Palace: Audience Chamber|JP-L-jabbaspalaceaudiencechamber.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Jawas
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
